registration_stage: After D1/D2 screening and frozen-control confirmation; before any D04 execution or external final predictions
observed_pattern: Legacy Reactome128 selected pathways include identical observed member sets (max pairwise Jaccard1); real128 concatenation did not outperform its size/degree-matched random prior. Full development errors remain in B and shifted donors.
candidate_explanation: Redundant correlated pathway summaries add feature dimensions without useful independent information.
planned_change: Train-only PCA compression of fixed128 train-variance-selected Reactome membership proxies to32 components. Preserve Geneformer frozen768 representation and the baseline-selected logistic C/class_weight.
negative_control: Degree- and pathway-size-preserving edge swaps on each fitted selected128 membership set, seed42, compressed identically to32 using training cells only.
fixed_components: Same4096 D0 natural training IDs, same validation/evaluation IDs, Geneformer base checkpoint/full4096 tokenizer/CLS feature cache, logistic head family and baseline C/class_weight, seed42.
pathway_policy: Reactome92 human Ensembl mapping;10–200 observed genes; select128 using only current inner/outer training feature variance. Never reuse legacy label-selected pathway identities.
compression_policy: Training StandardScaler of128 pathway proxies then PCA32, no whitening and no dimensionality search.
evaluation: All4 grouped donor folds, all63036 development cells, one fixed seed42. Same ordered evaluation cells and source hashes checked. Report donor-paired differences and fixed-label F1; exploratory rather than3-seed confirmation.
success_or_rejection_rule: Support compression hypothesis only if real_PCA32 exceeds real128 and the dimension-matched random_PCA32, with nonnegative real-vs-random differences in at least5/8 donors. Otherwise report no support; do not retune dimensions.
reason_not_promoted: D1/partial confirmation and the fixed8-candidate external batch were already specified. This third data-centric diagnostic must not rewrite their selection history.
